project: Wuxia Life P91 Medical Late-Life Playable Implementation
description: Implement the medical late-life stage for medical_sage_healer tavern_hand seed — 1 auto event with 6 branches (2 variants × 3 choices), full expression updates (cost label, current goal, late-life identity, life memory, summary), targeted proof, and regression tests. Strictly follows P90 late-life contract.

userStories.title: Wire medical late-life spine event (6 branches)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the medical late-life auto event wired through the existing event system so players on the medical route encounter a real late-life milestone with 6 distinct branches based on payoff choice.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure medical_late_life auto event in sample-lines-spine.json (age 52-56)
Trigger conditions: medical_payoff_done + age range + exclusivity guard + no orthodox/demonic
Event sets medical_late_life_done checkpoint flag + medical_late_life_identity_done
Branching logic: based on payoff choice marker (6 options: 3 compassionate + 3 pragmatic)
Compassionate branch markers: tavern_medical_late_compassionate_final / peaceful / legacy
Pragmatic branch markers: tavern_medical_late_pragmatic_fallen / wanderer / master
Correct stat changes per branch (per P90 contract section 5): Comp-A +3, Comp-B +7, Comp-C +10, Prag-A -6, Prag-B +3, Prag-C +13
No new event framework or scheduler
P83/P84/P85/P87/P89 existing evidence does not regress
userStories.notes: 1 auto event with 6 branches = more complex than renown late-life (3 branches). Core runtime wiring for medical late-life.

userStories.title: Add late-life player-facing expression — sample line (core P0)
userStories.description: As a player, I want the medical late-life stage reflected in my sample line status so the route feels like it has a meaningful late-life identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Sample line cost label: payoff state → late-life state (6 distinct labels: 最后仁心 / 从容自在 / 仁心传承 / 人走茶凉 / 逍遥自在 / 德高望重)
Sample line current goal: payoff state → late-life state (6 distinct goals)
Gate order: medical_late_life_done > medical_payoff_done > medical_midlife_pressure_done > medical_on_ramp_done > tavern_medical_bridge_crossed > base
At least 2 late-life-specific readable signals (cost label + current goal)
Six branches have meaningfully different expressions, not reskinned
Two variants have genuinely different expressions (compassionate = body/spirit, pragmatic = social/position)
Preserve tavern-born medical healer flavor
No new UI components
userStories.notes: Core P0 expression surfaces. 6 branches × 2 signals = 12 expression updates.

userStories.title: Add late-life player-facing expression — late-life identity (core P0)
userStories.description: As a player, I want a late-life identity summary that deepens my age-40 identity so the late-life stage feels like it defines who I become.
acceptanceCriteria: medicalAge40Identity() checks medical_late_life_identity_done first, then falls back to medical_age40_identity_done
Comp-A: 燃尽自己的最后仁心
Comp-B: 从容自在的老者
Comp-C: 仁心满天下的老宗师
Prag-A: 失势的老御医
Prag-B: 逍遥自在的老游医
Prag-C: 德高望重的老名医
Six branches have meaningfully different identity descriptions
Preserve tavern-born medical healer flavor (tavern, old shopkeeper, etc.)
userStories.notes: Core P0 identity surface. 6 unique late-life identities — deeper than age-40 identities.

userStories.title: Add late-life player-facing expression — ordinary origin (bonus P1)
userStories.description: As a player, I want additional late-life-specific expressions in the ordinary origin view so the late-life stage feels richer and more memorable.
acceptanceCriteria: Ordinary origin current goal: late-life state update (consistent with sample line)
Ordinary origin life memory: late-life-specific text (different per branch, 6 total)
Ordinary origin summary: late-life state update (different per branch, 6 total)
Gate order matches sample line
Preserve tavern-born medical healer flavor
No new UI components
userStories.notes: Bonus P1 expression surfaces. Life memory and summary depth. 3 surfaces × 6 branches = 18 expression updates.

userStories.title: Add targeted late-life proof (6 branches)
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded proof artifact showing that the medical late-life event fires correctly, all 6 branches work, and tavern-born healer flavor is preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce 1 targeted proof (payoff → late-life → expression changes path verification, both variants × 3 choices)
Show core nodes: pre-late-life baseline → event fires → 6 branches flags+stats → cost label per branch → current goal per branch → late-life identity per branch

Optional bonus nodes: life memory, origin summary, full chain traceback, variant differentiation (body/spirit vs social/position), 6-branch differentiation, cross-route distinction, tavern-born flavor check
No full lifetime exhaust required
Proof supports whether to continue endgame stage decision
Save as docs/test-reports/p91-medical-late-life-targeted-proof.md
userStories.notes: Targeted proof covering all 6 late-life branches + 2 variants.

userStories.title: Add narrow regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow tests guarding the medical late-life stage so future edits do not break the first medical late-life milestone.
acceptanceCriteria: New test file covering late-life stage (1 auto event × 6 branches)
Group 1: Event wiring — event exists, auto type, age range, conditions, 6 branch markers
Group 2: Pre-late-life state — state verification after payoff before late-life (both variants)
Group 3: Compassionate 3 branches post-late-life — flags + stats + cost label + current goal
Group 4: Pragmatic 3 branches post-late-life — flags + stats + cost label + current goal
Group 5: Late-life identity (6 branches, P0)
Group 6: Two-variant differentiation — compassionate ≠ pragmatic (body/spirit vs social/position)
Group 7: Six-branch differentiation — all 6 branches different
Group 8: Distinct from renown late-life (healer vs jianghu networker)
Group 9: No regression of P83/P84/P85/P87/P89
Reuse existing test harness
All relevant commands pass
userStories.notes: ~60-70 regression assertions across 9 groups. Covers both variants + all 6 branches.

userStories.title: Produce P91 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report stating exactly what the medical late-life stage now provides and whether endgame stage is justified next.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p91-medical-late-life-closure-report.md
Summarize event wiring, expressions, proof, tests
State whether subsequent endgame / final legacy stage is worth opening (GO / NO-GO)
List larger medical-expansion items that remain deferred
All 14 closure criteria satisfied (from P90 validation shape)
userStories.notes: Closure and GO/NO-GO for P92 medical endgame design-first stage.
